rules.name: OFFER NO FIRM FOUNDATIONS
rules.text: At your [Sacred Site] , Build actions add [Explorer] instead of [Town] / [City] .
rules.evidence: seed 1: build l1; add-piece l1 explorer; count l1 explorer 2, city 0 (base would add a City: 1 Town, 0 City). Seeds 7/2: cascaded Blight destroyed Mud's Presence first, so no Sacred Site at Build and the base City is built (correct).
rules.notes: Two exception rules, scoped to the build L episode and filtered by the Sacred Site. The replacement re-emits the same predicate (add-piece) with different arguments and does NOT loop, unlike the Badlands damage-dahan case where the replacement matches the pattern again. Works because core makes 'Build adds a Town/City' an add-piece episode inside build L.

language_issues: Two Blight additions in parallel (the land's own Blight and a cascade into it) both read the same Presence at their start and both 'destroy' it (move q2 destroyed twice) instead of destroying two different Presence; same sibling-concurrency issue as the missed cascade. Workaround: serialize Blight additions (not done).
